about.title: About Me
about.text:
Hi! My name is Anna Clara, and I'm a fourth-semester Computer Science student at UNINOVE.

My goal is to secure my first opportunity in the technology field, where I can continue learning while contributing to the development of meaningful solutions. I enjoy turning problems into real-world solutions through programming, and I see every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

I'm currently studying and developing projects to continuously improve my technical skills and build functional, intuitive, and well-structured applications. I believe that practice is the best way to learn, which is why I'm constantly starting new projects and exploring new technologies to improve them.

In this portfolio, you'll find some of the projects I've developed throughout my journey. Each one represents a challenge I've overcome, new knowledge I've gained, and an important step in my growth as a developer.
Feel free to explore them and learn more about my work.
